svg.aria-label: Access switch ports, all on the top row (odd numbers): Gi1/0/1 access VLAN 10 admin workstation; Gi1/0/3 trunk 20 and 30 UniFi AP-1, ground floor, native VLAN 10; Gi1/0/5 trunk 20 and 30 UniFi AP-2, first floor, native VLAN 10; Gi1/0/7 access VLAN 20 internal workstation; Gi1/0/9, 11, 13 and 15 access VLAN 50 PoE cameras; Gi1/0/17 access VLAN 50 NVR; Gi1/0/19 access VLAN 10 R720 NIC1 Proxmox management; Gi1/0/21 trunk 20 and 40 R720 NIC2 VM traffic; Gi1/0/23 access VLAN 40 UniFi UNAS Pro; even ports and ports 25 to 48 shut down; Te1/0/1-2 LACP trunk to the core switch.
